notes: Event pages may contain multiple dated or threshold conditional markets.
Each supplied event URL is stored once; questionnaire variables reference event IDs.
The questionnaire remains binary: each variable is rated Up or Down over the selected observation window.

variables.up: Diplomacy or continued de-escalation becomes more likely.
variables.down: Diplomacy or continued de-escalation becomes less likely.

variables.questionnaire_header: Iranian blockade ends by near-term deadline — odds
variables.up: The blockade ending by the selected near-term deadline becomes more likely.
variables.down: The blockade ending by the selected near-term deadline becomes less likely.
variables.conditional_market_rule: Use the nearest relevant unresolved dated contract.

variables.questionnaire_header: Iranian blockade ends by long-term deadline — odds
variables.up: The blockade ending by the selected long-term deadline becomes more likely.
variables.down: The blockade ending by the selected long-term deadline becomes less likely.
variables.conditional_market_rule: Use the furthest relevant unresolved dated contract, currently the year-end side of the curve when available.

variables.up: Disrupted traffic, closures, fees, military action, or successful attacks become more likely.
variables.down: Normal traffic becomes more likely and disruption outcomes become less likely.

variables.up: Selected WTI or crude-oil upside thresholds become more likely.
variables.down: Selected WTI or crude-oil upside thresholds become less likely.
variables.conditional_market_rule: Treat selected upside thresholds as a basket rather than relying on one strike.
